regime_context: Detector state for China A-shares shows an extremely narrow, one-narrative tape: Coal leads at rank 1 with the only positive 'eligible' momentum among growth-type themes, while Banks (rank 2, eligible) is crowded and exhibits strong durability/trend texture. Breadth of rotation is 0.14 (3 of 22 eligible), absorption is 0.36, and the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold edge on this market's history (gate_helps false), so discipline is downgraded to experimental; momentum rank is a focus lens only. Do not read this as a return forecast.
emerging_watch: Watch SOE Blue Chips / 中特估 — rank 3, durability 0.87 (trend), breadth 0.75, but currently ineligible and crowded (z=1.68, no ETF proxy). If it REGAINS eligibility (i.e. transitions into the same trend-eligible state held by Banks) while Coal's momentum decays toward Banks' score, that would be the observable condition to retire this watch and treat a value-complex handoff as confirmed, not predicted.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the ONLY eligible theme with positive momentum (score 0.8, rank 1) and the current one-narrative leader (margin 0.043 over Banks), supported by intact trend eligibility. However durability is middling (0.49, hurst 'mixed', breadth only 0.30), meaning leadership is concentrated but not cohesive — a fragility, not a strength. Lean long only while it holds trend eligibility; no edge is claimed from the momentum rank itself.
theses.dissent: Coal's narrow breadth (0.30) shows the rally rests on a few names, and 'mixed' hurst + mid durability means an abrupt reversal (typical China policy-driven coal moves) could whipsaw trend logic exactly as the backtest warns (gate did_NOT_hold_here).

falsifier.text: 515220.SS (Coal ETF) closes below its 50-day moving average and loses eligibility on the next detector update before 2026-11-27

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks shows the strongest internal structure of any eligible theme: durability 0.82 (trend tag), breadth 0.833, rank 2 — and is the confirmed challenger behind Coal. Crowding (z=1.83, crowded=true) is a SIZE-DOWN caution only, not a fade. The rotation margin is tiny (0.043) and directional=false, so a confirmed handoff has NOT occurred — but Banks is the only legitimate second leg. Lean long with an underweight-tilt while the trend and breadth hold.
theses.dissent: Crowding at z=1.83 is extreme — this breadth + crowding texture often marks a late-stage acceptance of the value/style trade (SOE blue chips and Baijiu are ALSO crowded), and any macro shock to credit or property exposure would hit Banks hardest.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS (Banks ETF) breaks below its 20-day low and breadth falls below 0.6 on the next detector update

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Rank 11, score -0.135, but eligible=true yet crowded (z=1.17) with mixed trend and very weak breadth (0.214). The eligibility flag here is not backed by breadth or durability — a negative-score, crowded, eligible theme in a mean-reverting tape is a trap. Avoid chasing; the trend gate has no drawdown edge on this market (gate_helps false), so no protection from a crowded momentum failure.
theses.dissent: Innovative Pharma could be a diversifying destination if the Coal/Banks value complex rolls over and flows rotate to an uncrowded, policy-favored healthcare theme — but current detector texture gives zero confirmatory signal.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ (Pharma CXO ETF) rises above its 50-day moving average with breadth above 0.5 and decrowds to z<1.0, while Coal loses eligibility
